text:
maria gomez: heads-up — customer reported an unexpected token charge after a streaming request retried and a tool call executed. looks like tokens for the tool call and the resumed stream both got billed.

devon park: which route did the request take? any region fallback?

maria gomez: customer traces show it bounced from eu-west to us-central on retry (routing fallback). request id rQ-9a3. first attempt timed out, client retried with same request_id but different attempt id.

lee chen: that sounds like our current routing policy: non-sticky fallback -> new session -> no shared KV prefix so stream restarted from 0, toolcall executed again. 

maria gomez: right. payload included a tool call: `{\"tool\":\"search\",\"q\":\"price of GPU\"}`. the tool produced ~120 tokens, stream resumed and produced ~800 tokens. billing shows ~920 on attempt1 + ~800 on attempt2 = double charge for the tool result.

sana rao: billing-bot says: `charge_breakdown: attempt_1: 920, attempt_2: 800, dedupe: none` — opsbot logged a routing fallback at 2039123465.

billing-bot: Note: current dedupe only runs for identical request_ids within 60s for sync generation. streaming retries and toolcalls are not deduped.

devon park: we need to decide on behavior: (A) enforce sticky routing during in-flight streams so retry reattaches to same session, (B) extend dedupe logic to consider toolcall hashes + request_id, or (C) treat first-toolcall results as provisional and credit on duplicate executions. thoughts?

lee chen: (A) seems simplest for correctness, but sticky routing reduces routing flexibility and hurts failover. (B) is tricky because we don't currently surface toolcall hashes through all routing hops. (C) requires us to implement provisional billing and reconciliation which billing team hates.

maria gomez: important UX point for Console: customers see a billing spike in the last 24h and assume we double-billed them. we should add telemetry fields so console can show "provisional charges" vs "final charges" during rollouts.

sana rao: concrete next steps: improve telemetry first. add `attempt_id`, `stream_chunk_id`, and `toolcall_hash` to our request envelope and event logs. that lets billing run deterministic dedupe post-hoc.

devon park: agree. small API change: add header `X-RW-Attempt-Id` and include `stream_chunk_id` on stream frames. we can gate it behind a rollout flag.

lee chen: on routing side I'll sketch a sticky option for in-flight streams that can be enabled per-customer via Dedicated config. fallback will still be allowed after grace window.

maria gomez: can we also make the Console show "provisional billing" for streaming sessions during retries? UX: flag line-items with yellow if dedupe not yet confirmed.

sana rao: yep, dashboard change is straightforward once billing emits `provisional=true` for those events. devon, can you add the header and event fields and a minimal telemetry schema?

devon park: will do. creating ticket now. PR to add header + stream_chunk_id to runtime logs. also adding a small heuristic on billing side to compare `toolcall_hash` by request_id across attempts.

maria gomez: i'll message account team to proactively notify impacted customers and add notes in the Console billing widget. if we can't automatically credit within 48h, we'll escalate to manual refunds.

opsbot: deploy scheduled: staging rollout of telemetry fields at 2039123490, canary to 1% traffic.

lee chen: follow-ups:
- telemetry PR: @devon park
- routing sticky opt-in: @lee chen
- console provisional UI: @maria gomez / @sana rao
- billing dedupe heuristics: @billing-bot / @sana rao

maria gomez: thanks all. capturing notes into a short incident doc. hoping telemetry + small billing heuristic resolves most cases without a mass refund. :fingers_crossed:

devon park: quick example log we should index: 
``` 
request_id=rQ-9a3 attempt_id=a1 stream_chunk_id=0 toolcall_hash=sha256:4f3c... charged_tokens=920 region=eu-west
request_id=rQ-9a3 attempt_id=a2 stream_chunk_id=0 toolcall_hash=sha256:4f3c... charged_tokens=800 region=us-central
```

lee chen: if `toolcall_hash` matches and request_id matches, billing can auto-credit duplicate toolcall tokens and only charge resumed stream delta. good win.

sana rao: i'll spin up the billing ticket and add acceptance criteria: auto-credit when `request_id` matches and `toolcall_hash` equal across attempts, within 5 minutes.

maria gomez: perfect. closing thread here, will link the incident doc once created."
